items.actClause: AN ACT to direct the department of environmental conservation to authorize the installation of a dry hydrant on Colgate Lake in the town of Jewett, county of Greene
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S3898

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to direct the department of environmental conservation to authorize the
installation of a dry hydrant on Colgate Lake in the town of Jewett,
county of Greene

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:
Authorizes the Department of
Environmental Conservation (DEC) to permit a dry hydrant for the Town
of Jewett.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
This legislation would amend the State
Law to permit the construction of a dry hydrant as defined by the
state fire code at Colgate Lake in the Town of Jewett.

The second section of this bill provides for an immediate effective
date.

JUSTIFICATION:
The Catskill Park State Land Master Plan does not allow
the installation of dry hydrants as fire control devices because they
are not defined as conforming use structures in the park's current
land use regulations. The Town of Jewett appealed to DEC as the
park's master plan was revised just two years ago so that these
structures would be included in the updated use plan, but the
department rejected the town's request to add the necessary language.

The Town of Jewett's officials, fire district and safety
administrators, and residents feel that this element is a necessary
addition for the health and safety of the park's surrounding
communities.
Accordingly, this legislation seeks to authorize the town to install a
dry hydrant at Colgate Lake for public safety and fire control
purposes.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:
None to the state. Costs associated with installing the dry
hydrant and necessary fire control infrastructure would be borne
by the Town of Jewett or appropriate fire district.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act would take effect immediately.
